an5.72:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca. paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca.
an5.72:1.3: aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā; pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā,
an5.72:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā cetovimuttiphalā ca honti cetovimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca. paññāvimuttiphalā ca honti paññāvimuttiphalānisaṃsā ca.
an5.72:1.5: yatoca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cetovimutto ca hoti paññāvimutto ca,
an5.72:1.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho itipi saṅkiṇṇaparikho itipi abbūḷhesiko itipi niraggaḷo itipi ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto itipi.
an5.72:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an5.72:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ukkhittapaligho hoti.
an5.72:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno ponobhaviko jātisaṃsāro pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an5.72:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saṅkiṇṇaparikho hoti.
an5.72:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti, ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an5.72:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu abbūḷhesiko hoti.
an5.72:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni pahīnāni honti ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvakatāni āyatiṃ anuppādadhammāni.
an5.72:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu niraggaḷo hoti.
an5.72:6.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hoti?
an5.72:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno asmimāno pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
an5.72:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo pannaddhajo pannabhāro visaṃyutto hotī’ti.
